title: TelemetryEvent
description: Opt-in fleet telemetry event. Contains NO raw biometrics. Only emitted after explicit driver consent (telemetry_opt_in=true).

tier.description: Maximum drowsiness tier reached in this event

duration_s.description: Duration of the event in seconds

_privacy_note: This schema intentionally excludes raw EAR/MAR/PERCLOS/EEG/ECG values. Only aggregate event metadata is transmitted.
